values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Line 200 and Line 300 expansion is part of the Driftwood Pipeline that supplies feed gas to the Woodside Louisiana LNG export terminal. A Woodside project page describes the pipeline project, and a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission notice from May 2025 treats the pipeline and the terminal as one project.

verifications.note: Woodside project page for the Driftwood Pipeline Line 200 and Line 300 project, which supplies feed gas to Woodside Louisiana LNG.
Notice names Driftwood Pipeline LLC and the Woodside Louisiana LNG Project it is built for.

records.researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration list also gives LNG as the demand served. The sheet has no terminal name here. The terminal file lists both Louisiana LNG Terminal and Woodside Louisiana LNG Terminal, and the sheet's mainline row P0177 uses Driftwood LNG Terminal. The Woodside page is about the whole Line 200 and 300 system, so this phase is covered only as part of it.
